channels.name: flagger_signal_observation
channels.method: same-frame original signal-asset and flagger readback
channels.reference_frame: Native world frame and reviewed approach

channels.name: motorcycle_response
channels.method: original vehicle body, velocity and stop-line join
channels.reference_frame: Native world XY and marked stop line
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; Native motion requires physical review

channels.name: four_view_video
channels.method: synchronized original overview, approach, reference_corner, driver_reference sources
channels.uncertainty: Original signal, zone and subject visibility require review

channels.name: dev.human_direction
channels.method: Same-frame source join: Requested stop/release per Native frame plus original flagger identity and independent signal-pixel interpretation; requested signal alone does not establish the visible indication
channels.reference_frame: Native frame joined to source and review identifiers
channels.uncertainty: Prospective channel; requires_original_source_and_pixel_review; missing original source or review remains unknown

channels.name: dev.governs
channels.method: Same-frame source join: Reviewed flagger orientation and signal direction relative to motorcycle approach, joined to original subject and signal frames
channels.reference_frame: Native frame joined to source and review identifiers
channels.uncertainty: Prospective channel; requires_original_source_and_pixel_review; missing original source or review remains unknown

channels.name: dev.temporary_traffic_control
channels.method: Same-frame source join: Source-reviewed temporary-zone designation and original road/zone geometry; road layout alone does not establish designation
channels.reference_frame: Native frame joined to source and review identifiers
channels.uncertainty: Prospective channel; requires_original_source_and_pixel_review; missing original source or review remains unknown

channels.name: drv.within_signed_zone
channels.method: Same-frame source join: Original motorcycle body position per joined frame against reviewed marked-zone limits and sign pixels
channels.reference_frame: Native frame joined to source and review identifiers
channels.uncertainty: Prospective channel; requires_original_source_and_pixel_review; missing original source or review remains unknown

channels.name: dev.zone_sign
channels.method: Same-frame source join: Original camera pixels and independent sign-content review, bound to source-reviewed temporary-zone record
channels.reference_frame: Native frame joined to source and review identifiers
channels.uncertainty: Prospective channel; requires_original_source_and_pixel_review; missing original source or review remains unknown

channels.name: kin.velocity
channels.method: Same-frame source join: Original motorcycle velocity from PipelineCapture trace and observed Native speed over 600 joined frames
channels.reference_frame: Native frame joined to source and review identifiers
channels.uncertainty: Prospective channel; requires_original_source_and_pixel_review; missing original source or review remains unknown

channels.name: drv.stopped
channels.method: Same-frame source join: Observed low-speed interval during requested stop, with body position relative to stop line; no legal stopping threshold inferred
channels.reference_frame: Native frame joined to source and review identifiers
channels.uncertainty: Prospective channel; requires_original_source_and_pixel_review; missing original source or review remains unknown

channels.name: drv.officer_directed
channels.method: Same-frame source join: Derived direction only after source-reviewed flagger authorization, governance and original signal pixels; unresolved until independent review
channels.reference_frame: Native frame joined to source and review identifiers
channels.uncertainty: Prospective channel; requires_original_source_and_pixel_review; missing original source or review remains unknown
